{{Infobox map |name=Savage Towers |year=2021 |image=Savage.jpg |creator=Link/Quaker |gametype=4on4 |size=Large }} Savage Towers (savage.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created from March to May 2021 by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]] and [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]].
The map was originally made by the Single Player mapper ''Ankh'' from Denmark [[Image:flag_dk.gif]]. The title name was "Hangover Devastation". Quaker did a full rebuild because of FPS issues. The original map (hdn.bsp) had great potential and looked pretty good in size, no adding of rooms or deleting of realestate was needed. To convert this into a playable 4on4 map, a lot of editing was done. It takes a little time to learn the maps tricks but the map is real different from any other. There are 9 spawnpoints. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=2 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=3 |ra=1 |ya=2 |ga=1 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=2 |ng= |ssg=3 }} ==Gallery== Savage_LG.png Savage_tower_big.png Savage_tower_outside.png Savage_tower_RA.png Savage_waterpillars.png Savage_YA.png ==Layout== Savage Towers got a large main room with a huge tower in the middle of it. Another tower is located not far away. These 2 towers got a lot of important items in it. One RL and the LG are located away from the towers. A lot of trickery on this map and when you learn the routes the map is fast paced. The map got 2 quads and one quad needs to be opened by a button; you got 2 buttons that both open that quad. Despite some of the large areas the map brings you tight hallways and small rooms as well; all kinds of fights will happen.

{{Col}} ==Strategy & Tactics== As the map name mentions, the 2 towers are what you need to take advantage of. The big main room with the big tower got everything...except the LG. However the tower got multiple ways to get in and out of so guarding it wont be easy. Also the large area surrounding the tower can not be covered by 1 player, maybe not 2 either. The other tower should be less difficult to control. Also you got a RL, the LG and other important items in other isolated locations. The 2 quads also presents a challenge as it will be very hard to time both of them; only pixel perfect teamplay will do that. ===Download=== You can download the map, loc file and 24 bit textures [https://upload.foppa.dk/files/Savage.zip HERE] __NOTOC__
